recommendations.title: Immediate Relaunch using High-ROI Creative
recommendations.detail: Relaunch a new Messenger conversation campaign immediately using the 'LEGIT SURE 100%' creative (ID: 120208137194060625). This asset has a proven historical cost-per-message of $29.18, which is 55% cheaper than the recent account average of $65.34.

recommendations.title: Deploy 'Low DP' Xpander Offer
recommendations.detail: Structure the new campaign around the 'Xpander GLX AT | Low DP' offer. This ad reached a peak CTR of 8.22%, indicating high market resonance. Use the 'Metro South' region and 25–55 age segment which provided the strongest engagement signals before the account went dark.

recommendations.title: Audience Broadening to Combat CPM
recommendations.detail: The current CPM of $404.44 is unsustainably high. When relaunching, move away from hyper-niche targeting and test 'Broad' (Age/Gender/Location only) or larger Interest stacks to allow the algorithm to find cheaper impressions within the Metro South region.

recommendations.title: Budget Reallocation to Sales Objective
recommendations.detail: Historical data shows the 'JULY ADS 2026' campaign (Sales objective) outperformed the 'Leads' objective campaign in CTR (4.33% vs 1.98%). Allocate 70% of the relaunch budget to the Sales objective optimized for 'Click to Message' to maximize intent.
